concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-create-node]] - Braintree Node.js guide to stored-payment-method and plan prerequisites, plan-derived subscription setup, and start-date or trial-dependent creation, charge and status timing
warnings: Preserve the Node.js guide scope and do not turn its examples into a complete request schema.
Keep payment-method vaulting, first-transaction 3DS nonce and merchant-account currency prerequisites discoverable.
Distinguish submitting a transaction for settlement from completed settlement.
Retain the immediate, future-date and trial conditions when describing creation, charge attempts and status changes.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-create-node]] - Node.js recurring-billing guide for vaulted payment-method and plan prerequisites, plan inheritance, and immediate, future-date or trial-dependent initial transaction flow
warnings: Keep this guide distinct from the dedicated subscription-create request reference, which owns detailed request shapes.
Preserve the plan-currency condition and the difference between settlement submission and settlement completion.
Do not infer later subscription lifecycle behavior beyond the initial flows stated in the primary guide.
